content: Let it first blossom, then bear fruit, then ripen. Why do you wish to grasp the fruit before its season?
author: Epictetus
story:
Born into slavery in Hierapolis and physically crippled by a brutal master in imperial Rome, Epictetus acquired his freedom after Nero's death and founded a renowned philosophical academy in Nicopolis. Having experienced genuine subjugation, he founded his philosophy on the inviolable inner freedom of the human will: chains may bind the body, but no tyrant can conquer the faculty of choice.

This timeless reminder speaks to the universal struggle to balance inner truth with outer demands. Epictetus understood that the measure of a meaningful life is not external approval, but the quiet integrity with which we meet each day's encounters.
reflectionPrompt: How can aligning with nature's patient, unhurried timing bring calm to your current situation?
